name: NNJ-40 "Thunderbolt" long-range ion cannon
description: The NNJ-40 "Thunderbolt" long-range ion cannon was a model of ion cannon manufactured by Borstel Galactic Defense. It was the main armament of the Galactic Republic's RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank. During the Imperial Era, an Imperial science vessel was armed with one such cannon.
